annotations.title: Delete an offering, a need, the party or the account

description: Delete one offering, one need, the whole party, or the entire account. Always requires the owner's approval: the result is status=awaiting_owner with a link. To hide something temporarily, set status=paused via save_offerings / save_need / save_party instead. Contacts already revealed to counterparts cannot be recalled.

client_request_id.description: Idempotency key: repeating a call with the same key returns the original result. New key per intended action.
